rulings.reason: Half of the composite scores a property of the QUESTION (bounded/personal vs broad/scholarly), which is a topic-scope marker about the stimulus rather than evidence about the answer that is the item, and the register half only asks whether the pitch matches that scope. A high score therefore certifies the kind of exchange this is, not the substance of the answer; routed mixed because bounded prompts do plausibly admit genuinely complete, exactly-right answers.

The anchors make address the dominant axis: an impersonal answer scores 0 no matter how actionable it is, and actionability only separates 10 from 5, so a judge scoring this instruction is mainly reading second-person register. Mixed because handing the asker an executable next step does plausibly co-occur with genuine responsiveness to what they actually needed.

The two extremes hold narration constant (strong at both 10 and 0) and vary only stance, so by construction the criterion is a pure companionable-vs-dismissive tone dial with the explanatory content cancelled out. Not mixed: the upstream cause is author politeness, which the proposer's own exemplar (R03, enthusiastic narration over a wrong derivation) shows does not carry mathematical quality, while the dismissive pole can accompany a genuinely simpler correct solution.

As written, a confidently asserted wrong answer scores 10 and a correct answer prefaced with 'I think' scores 0, so the instruction measures assertive register rather than whether the content is right. Mixed because hedging and explicit self-disclaimers ('this is not an answer to the question') often do track genuine incompleteness or uncertainty in the mathematics.

The discriminating axis is placement, not presence: the same decisive identity or counterexample scores 10 in sentence one and 0 in paragraph three, which makes this an organizational/presentation marker of the sort the protocol assigns to Track B. Mixed because an author who can state the verdict immediately plausibly has a crisper and more correct result to state.

The composite is gated on the question being elementary or narrowly computational, so a fully rigorous, gapless answer to a hard question is forced to 0 and is scored identically to a bad answer on an easy one, making the criterion non-monotone in answer quality and dependent on a topic-scope marker. Mixed, and strongly so: the second half (carrying the derivation to a fully determined object with every step shown) is genuine craft and would route A if proposed unbundled from the scope gate.
